question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

By the same token
solution:
The correct answer is** 'In the same way'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'By the same token' **is **'In the same way'.**
 
• **By the same token**: in the same way or for the same reason. (उसी तरह या उसी कारण से)
 
 
• *Example: There was little evidence to substantiate the gossip and, **by** **the same token**, there was little to disprove it.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *In the same way.*
